authority_note: This repository contract operationalizes but does not replace the unique CURRENT rule file.

result_classes.TECHNICAL_PASS: Code/CI/hash/artifact/numerical execution passed; no predictive authority.
result_classes.SCIENTIFIC_COMPONENT_PASS: Frozen candidate beat frozen baseline under chronological OOS scientific gate; research evidence only.
result_classes.CONFIRMATION_PASS: Exact frozen method repeated on untouched/disjoint/forward evidence and passed again.
result_classes.FORMAL_PROMOTION_PASS: Scientific + confirmation + PIT runtime availability + runtime integrity + explicit domain promotion receipt.
result_classes.STOP_DATA_COVERAGE: Stopped before target-label/model-fit stage because admissible coverage/input was insufficient.

scientific_gate.same_day_leakage: forbidden; predict same-date fixtures before updating with any same-date outcomes
scientific_gate.primary_metric: task-appropriate LogLoss/Log Score versus frozen baseline
scientific_gate.primary_uncertainty: preregistered 90% resampling interval upper bound for challenger-minus-baseline must be < 0
scientific_gate.fold_stability: at least 2/3 rolling test folds improve primary metric
scientific_gate.calibration: slope/intercept and task-appropriate reliability diagnostics must be reported

formal_promotion.scope: competition/domain specific unless cross-domain evidence explicitly passes
requires: admissible PIT inputs available at runtime
explicit formal promotion receipt allowed by CURRENT

fixed_sample_policy.minimum_sample: must be frozen zero-label per experiment based on coverage/design
